title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-olivia-hart-samira-patel-2026-09-15
content:
Purpose: prep notes for weekly 1:1 with Olivia Hart (AE -> CSM alignment). Goal: surface high-priority customer items, escalate blockers, agree next steps for renewals/backlog.

Meeting logistics:
- When: 2026-09-16 10:30am PT (30m)
- Where: Zoom / gtm-cs weekly 1:1 link

Customers to highlight:
1) Lumen Health (tier: enterprise, renewal: 2027-01-15)
   - Health: amber -> stable but price pushback incoming; usage steady at ~1.2M tokens/day, embeddings 18k/week.
   - Recent issues: p99 latency spikes (220ms baseline p99 -> spikes to 420ms on 9/12 at 14:00 PT). Root cause appears to be autoscaling gap when dedicated pools hit burst ceiling. Engineering ticket JIRA-4821 open.
   - Ask: agree on short-term mitigation (temporary burst increase / routing to Hosted fallback) + commit plan for Dedicated pool resize before EOW.
   - Next step owner: Olivia to confirm with AE on pricing flexibility; Samira to coordinate capacity request with infra (cc: Aaron Li).

2) Acme Analytics (mid-market, expansion opp)
   - Health: green. Using Redwood Optimize recommendations; quantization profile reduced token cost ~18%.
   - Opportunity: upsell to Dedicated for reduced tail latency on high-concurrency queries. Sales signal: customer asked about SLOs and guaranteed throughput.
   - Next step owner: Olivia to set intro call between customer infra lead and solutions-eng.

3) Nimbus Retail (on Private deployment)
   - Health: yellow. Audit logs integration delayed; compliance team needs KMS key rotation docs.
   - Risk: delay could stall go-live planned for 2026-10-01.
   - Next step owner: Samira to get tech writeup from Private deployments eng (Ana Morales) and share to customer by 2026-09-18.

Agenda (high-level):
- Quick sync (5m): wins / urgent escalations
- Customer deep-dive (15m): Lumen Health (capacity + renewal posture)
- Pipeline & expansion (5m): Acme Analytics follow ups
- Ops & docs (5m): Nimbus KMS / audit log status + internal owners
- AOB & action review (end)

Preparation notes (things to bring to call):
- Lumen usage dashboard (tokens/day, peak we observed 9/12) — screenshot attached in Slack thread.
- JIRA-4821 summary and proposed mitigation options: (a) temporary Dedicated burst increase, (b) route sensitive traffic to Hosted with model parity, (c) short-term QoS throttling for non-critical routes.
- Pricing flexibility band: can offer up to 10% effective discount for 12-month commit or expanded seats (coordinate with sales).

Action items (tracked / owners / due dates):
- Samira: Pull detailed autoscaler logs for 9/12 spike and add to JIRA-4821 (due 2026-09-15)
- Olivia: Confirm AE willingness to discuss 12-month commit concession for Lumen (due 2026-09-17)
- Samira: Draft customer-facing capacity mitigation email and share for review (due 2026-09-15 EOD)
- Aaron Li (infra): Evaluate Dedicated pool resize estimate + cost delta and post to ticket (due 2026-09-17)
- Ana Morales (private deployments): Provide KMS rotation doc + timeline for Nimbus (due 2026-09-18)
- Olivia: Schedule Acme Analytics intro with solutions-eng (due 2026-09-20)

Open questions / notes to resolve:
- If Lumen refuses pricing terms, what is minimum acceptable commitment (need explicit guidance from sales leadership).
- Confirm Hosted model variant parity for critical routes (model versions and tokenization differences).
- Are there any feature flags we can flip for Lumen to reduce burstiness (e.g., client-side batching guidance)? Ask runtime team.

Quick wins to mention in 1:1 (talking points):
- Optimize success: Acme Analytics cost per request dropped ~18% after quantization change. Great cross-sell story.
- Support SLA: reduced average response time for priority incidents after SRE on-call adjustments last week.

Follow-up tracker (for next 1:1):
- Status of JIRA-4821 mitigations and infra estimate.
- Outcome of AE pricing conversation with Lumen.
- Nimbus KMS docs delivered and customer ack.
- Update on Acme Analytics intro & potential POC timeline.

Notes to self: keep meeting tight, surface clear asks for Olivia (AE) so she can move pricing/contract items. Avoid tech deep-dives — escalate to eng sync after 1:1 if needed.

References / links mentioned:
- Confluence: ACME QBR notes (https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ACME-QBR-2026)
- JIRA: JIRA-4821 (autoscale spike)
- Slack: #g2m-cs thread (thread id 16523)

Document history: drafted 2026-09-14 by Samira Patel. Updated 2026-09-15 with latest infra notes and action owners.
